titulo: Ratko Mladic, former general convicted of Bosnia genocide, dies
cuerpo: Ratko ⁠Mladic, convicted of genocide for orchestrating ​the 1995 massacre of at least 8,000 Muslims in a U.N.-designated "safe area" of Bosnia, Europe's worst atrocity since World War Two, died on Thursday in U.N. custody. France 24's correspondent in Belgrade, Laurent Rouy, has the latest.
